why: Language-agnostic vectors of the FEM physics fingerprint of the analysis settings shared by FEM 2D and FEM 3D: FNV-1a 64 (offset cbf29ce484222325, prime 100000001b3) over, for every setting that is not display-only in declaration order, its UTF-8 name, `=`, its value as 8 little-endian bytes (counts as u64, reals as IEEE 754 binary64 bits) and `;`. Display-only settings are left out, so a deformation scale edit keeps the fingerprint while a mode count edit changes it.
